agent_explanation: Fast body (speed ~57) moves ~1.05 in x per dt=0.025 step, far more than 0.2-thick wall (x 2.6-2.8). Positions jump from x=3.24 (right of wall) at step 5 to x=2.19 (left of wall) at step 6 while y stays inside wall span, so the centre segment pierces the wall between sampled steps. Despite 48 integration substeps, wall collision is missed, indicating collision/CCD is evaluated only at step boundaries or fails for thin walls at high speed.
